'''55 ABY''' or<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> '''55 After the Battle of Yavin''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> That year, [[Lenang O'Pali/Legends|Lenang O'Pali]]&ndash;[[Author/Legends|authored]] work ''[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo Reconsidered: A Patriot's Perspective]]'' was published. It discussed the historical role of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] "[[Core name/Legends|Thrawn]]" of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who was [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|defeated]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. The work covered Thrawn's ascension to power with a view supportive of his and [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s actions and critical of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and its heroes.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
55 ABY was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />
